description: Implement vekd Phase 4.1 Core: the vekd binary entry point, SQLite state management, master key handling, and systemd/supervisor process management. This is the foundation that all other vekd components build on.
steps: Create a new directory src/vekd/ for all vekd-specific source files to keep it separate from the vek CLI sources.

Create src/vekd/vekd_main.c - the entry point for the vekd binary. On startup it should: check if /var/lib/vek/ exists (first-run detection), initialize the SQLite database, load or generate the master key, and start the HTTP server on port 8080.

Create src/vekd/vekd_db.c and vekd_db.h - SQLite state management. Implement the schema from the design doc (apps, releases, env_vars, events, secrets, users tables). Include auto-migration on startup.

Create src/vekd/vekd_crypto.c and vekd_crypto.h - Master key management. Load key from /var/lib/vek/master.key (mode 0600). Provide encrypt/decrypt functions for secrets and env vars using the master key.

Create src/vekd/vekd_supervisor.c and vekd_supervisor.h - Process supervisor. Implement fork/exec for app processes, waitpid monitoring loop, automatic restart on crash, and process state tracking. Include systemd-run integration when systemd is available.
Create src/vekd/vekd_config.h - Constants and configuration (default port 8080, data directory /var/lib/vek/, port range 10000-19999 for apps, etc.).
Update the Makefile to add a 'vekd' target that compiles src/vekd/*.c plus shared dependencies (sqlite3.c, sha256.c) into build/vekd. Keep it as a separate binary from the vek CLI.
Create tests/test_vekd_db.c - Unit tests for the database layer (schema creation, CRUD operations on apps/releases/users tables).
acceptance_criteria: Running 'make vekd' successfully compiles the vekd binary at build/vekd
The vekd binary initializes its SQLite database with the correct schema when started
Master key is generated on first run and loaded on subsequent runs
The supervisor can fork a child process, detect its exit, and restart it
Unit tests for the database layer pass (make test includes test_vekd_db)
verification: Run 'make -C /projects/sandbox/vek vekd' and confirm it compiles without errors
Run 'make -C /projects/sandbox/vek test' and confirm all tests pass including any new vekd tests
findings: All 5 acceptance criteria met. vekd binary compiles cleanly with 'make vekd', SQLite DB initializes with correct schema, master key generates on first run and loads on subsequent runs, supervisor can fork/monitor/restart processes, all 16 unit tests pass. Integration tests for hello/arithmetic/functions/stdlib_pages show intermittent pre-existing failures unrelated to vekd changes. Used _GNU_SOURCE for POSIX feature access (usleep, clock_gettime, kill).
